findings.title: 库文件符号链接漏过布局判定
findings.evidence: Q=canon(parent(d)) misses a final DB-file symlink. Existing process_lock canonicalizes d itself (session_transport.rs:43-56) and creates its target-adjacent writer.lock (:57-62). x_execution_session.rs:171-178 calls it without rejecting file symlinks; launcher spawns S at :455 and X at :490 without waiting.
findings.counterexample: P=/abs/s; A=/abs/s-state; x.db=/abs/x/alias.db symlinks to existing /abs/s/x.db; writer.lock absent. ADR allows Q=/abs/x; X creates /abs/s/x.db.writer.lock inside measured P.
findings.required_change: Align comparison with resolved DB/write target, retaining existing layout coverage; amend Q2/Q8, rule 3-4 and add final-file-symlink rejection acceptance.
